scope: Current Cloud manual-deployment guides, CLI or native Gateway tasks, and each documented optional HTTP stop/wake path.

model_connections.claude: Existing accepted external Anthropic Messages-compatible endpoint fixture
model_connections.codex: External Responses-compatible endpoint using an isolated test-only adapter
model_connections.pi_opencode_hermes: OpenAI Chat Completions endpoint with tool support

opencode.wake_trigger: external GET /global/health followed by POST to retained session

limitations: Provider compatibility is scoped to the tested endpoints and model; official Anthropic/OpenAI accounts were not exercised.
Guest credential audits cover listed readable files and process environments, not exhaustive memory or disk forensics.
OpenCode direct cold POST timed out without creating a task message or output file; the final documented path uses external health wake, then a message to the retained session.
Examples are single-user trusted-task deployments, not multi-tenant production services.
The first OpenCode health request after cold startup can time out; the documented read-only health check uses bounded retries. Task POST requests are not automatically retried.

checks.browser: All five desktop and 390px mobile pages render without page-wide overflow; complete service source expands.
checks.runtime_source: Documented code executed with endpoint/model substitutions; CLI commands used the already-installed service test boxes, changing only the box name.
